rationale.hitl-workflow: Proposes ACIP and CIW gated inspection workflows for AI code.
rationale.oversight-explanation: EEL generates decision trees and documentation to aid human comprehension.
rationale.rules-based-checks: AGDV automates coverage analysis and consistency verification of documentation.
rationale.design-only: Specifies VIBE4M framework and metrics but has not implemented them.
rationale.framework: VIBE4M is a reference architecture for a code integration pipeline.
rationale.counterpoint: Argues against vibe coding hype and unreviewed AI code generation.
rationale.metrics: Defines metrics for quality and comprehensibility.
rationale.agentic: Analyzes vibe coding which generates complete code artifacts from prompts.
rationale.risk-quality: Substantive treatment of quality debt and code comprehensibility via mitigations.
rationale.risk-security: Devotes focal analysis to security vulnerabilities caused by vibe coding.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Devotes focal analysis to over-reliance and diminished human responsibility.
